title: FedXAI-IDS: Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning Framework for Collaborative Intrusion Detection in Distributed IIoT Environments
description: FedXAI-IDS is a federated intrusion-detection framework based on a residual MLP that studies collaborative learning under IID and non-IID (Dirichlet) client data distributions. It is evaluated on four datasets (CIC-IoT2023, Edge-IIoTset, UNSW-NB15 and Custom-Attack-Suite) and compares centralised training, FedAvg (IID and non-IID) and FedProx (non-IID), with Gradient×Input feature attribution. This release contains the GPU pipeline script, the Results (Section 4) tables as CSV and Excel files, and the Results figures (Figs. 3–7).
